integrity: The proof is self-contained. Direct incidence-algebra multiplication checks use a standalone standard-library Python program and recorded output; computational cases do not replace the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields, finite posets and ordered commuting involution tuples only; historical r=1 and Fortuin–Kasteleyn identities are not new. Recoverability is of the comparability graph Tutte polynomial, not graph or poset isomorphism. A broader representation-count theorem may imply the claimed bridge.
title: Commuting involution tuples in incidence algebras recover the comparability-graph Tutte polynomial
